title: fix(app-shell): a flow action whose run pauses closes with the action's own successMessage (objectui#12234)
body:
Fixes #12234
Clause-②: yes

Item 6 of the hosted-shape list card objectui#12211, split to its own card. Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 2, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01G5TSaEwbEQsKMjhzTB4rEd`.

## What was wrong

A flow action that declares a `successMessage` showed it only when its flow ran straight through. When the run paused on a screen, the action stayed silent at the pause (the ruled `{ success: true, silent: true }`), and the run then completed on `FlowRunner`'s terminal-success toast. That toast knew only the flow's words: the flow's own `successMessage`, else `flowRunner.completed`, which zh renders as 「流程「升级工单」已完成」. The action's message was never shown.

## What was measured before editing

- **The sentence has one producer.** On `origin/main` and on the hosted pin `d758f2f20d`, the only call of `t('flowRunner.completed', …)` outside tests is `FlowRunner`'s resume handler (`resumeWith`). That handler runs only after a launch paused on a screen. So the three reported case actions pause for input; they do not run straight through.
- **The straight-through path already works.** `judgeFlowLaunch` returns `{ success: true, data, reload }` for a `done` run, and the action runner toasts the action's `successMessage`. The existing control `'control: a COMPLETED run still toasts successMessage, …'` in both `refusedLaunch-9973` pins already reads that. `flowResponse.ts` drops nothing, so it is not edited.
- **There are two launch hosts, each with its own `FlowRunner` mount.** One is `useConsoleActionRuntime` (list views, SDUI pages, the declared-actions bar). The other is `RecordDetailView`, which renders an assigned record page such as `case_detail_page` inside its own `ActionProvider` and dispatches its header actions through its own `flowHandler`. A case record's 升级工单 / 关闭工单 / 认领工单 run through `RecordDetailView`. The fix therefore needs both hosts (see Deviations).
- **Localization.** Every surface that dispatches a declared action runs it through `useActionTextLocalizer` before `execute` (the record header, the list view, the declared-actions bar, `page:header`, `record:quick_actions`). The runner hands that same action object to the handler and to its own toast sink. So `action.successMessage` in the flow handler is already the localized copy that a straight-through run toasts. No second localization path is added.
- HotCRM's source is not readable from this session: the proxy answers 403 for that repository. The pause on those three actions is inferred from the single producer above, not read from their flow definitions.

## The change

- `ScreenFlowState` gains one optional member, `actionSuccessMessage`. It is the invoking action's `successMessage` as it reached the flow handler. Both hosts set it when a launch pauses (one line each).
- `FlowRunner`'s terminal-success toast reads, in order: that message, the flow's own `successMessage`, then the `flowRunner.completed` sentence. A blank string, or an `I18nLabel` map that no localizer resolved, counts as no message. This is the same rule the action runner applies to a rung.
- Precedence follows the card's ruling. Code reading found no recorded reason for the flow's message to win. The action's message comes first because that is what the same click shows when the run does not pause. `FlowSchema.successMessage` is documented as replacing a generic "Done", not as outranking the action's copy.
- Unchanged and still pinned: the pause stays silent; an intermediate step still toasts `flowRunner.nextStep`; a run that ends `refused` or fails after the pause shows no success toast; `FlowSchema.successMessage` stays off the translation surface.
- `FlowRunner`'s header has a new section on this: "The invoking action's `successMessage` closes the run (objectui#12234)".

## Deviations, and how the seat ruled them

Both were ruled in the seat's claim amendment `6124264136` on objectui#12234.

1. **`packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` joins the file surface (option A, accepted at review).** The edit adds one member to its `setScreenFlow` call. The test `RecordDetailView.flowActionSuccessMessage-12234.test.tsx` sits next to it. The claim's mechanism assumption placed the hand-off in `useConsoleActionRuntime` alone. Measured, the reported reach goes through the record page's own host, so a change limited to the listed surface would leave the reported case as it is. Neighbour check, read at dispatch time: the in-flight objectui#12233 and objectui#12198 branches do not touch `RecordDetailView.tsx`. objectui#12223 edits only a comment in `useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`, in a region this diff does not touch. Seat 1's claims were not read, because a dev does not read the board.
2. **The exported type `ScreenFlowState` gains an optional member.** `FlowRunnerProps` is unchanged; the member rides the existing `state` prop as per-run data, next to `runId` and `flowName`. `ScreenFlowState` is exported from the package entry, so this is an additive change to a published type: the PR's line is `Clause-②: yes`, and the changeset (round 2, `b3c549c3`) declares `@object-ui/app-shell` `minor`. Existing values of the type stay valid.

## Tests (code at `a015abaa`; round 2 at `b3c549c3` changes only the changeset)

- New: `FlowRunner.actionSuccessMessage-12234.test.tsx` (9 tests, real zh pack), `useConsoleActionRuntime.flowActionSuccessMessage-12234.test.tsx` (4 tests, action door, real runtime), and `RecordDetailView.flowActionSuccessMessage-12234.test.tsx` (2 tests, action door, real record page). Each asserts the full list of `toast.success` texts.
- Narrowed run: every test file under `packages/app-shell/src` and `apps/console/src` whose name matches `FlowRunner`, `useConsoleActionRuntime`, `flowResponse`, `flowLaunch`, `RecordDetailView`, `flow-envelope`, `FlowRunsPage`, `loadLanguage`, `FlowRefusal`, `DeclaredActionsBar` or `PageView.`, plus `ActionParamDialog.dialogReach-12080`. Result: `Test Files  88 passed (88)`, `Tests  635 passed (635)`. The narrowing is by name. It reaches the two hosts, the runner, the launch and response modules, and the `ScreenFlowState` consumers in `apps/console`. CI runs the full suite.
- Ablation 1: delete the action rung from `FlowRunner`'s toast, through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed, restored to the HEAD blob with an empty `git diff HEAD`). The predicted direction held: 5 red, 10 green. The red pins are the 3 terminal pins in the FlowRunner file and the paused pin in each host. The red message names the reported sentence: `expected [ [ '流程「升级工单」已完成' ] ] to deeply equal [ [ '工单已升级' ] ]`. The straight-through, refused, failed and control pins stayed green. A first attempt was refused by the tool as a no-op (the replacement was a substring of the anchor) and was restored without running; the delete form above is the run that counts.
- Ablation 2: delete the hand-off line in each host separately. With `RecordDetailView` mutated, its pin went red (1 failed, 1 passed): `expected [ 'Flow "Escalate" completed' ] to deeply equal [ 'Case escalated' ]`. With `useConsoleActionRuntime` mutated, its paused pin went red (1 failed, 3 passed). Both restores were verified against the HEAD blob.

## Gates (local, at `a015abaa`; the changeset gates were re-run at `b3c549c3`)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0. `tsc --listFilesOnly -p tsconfig.test.json` lists all three new test files.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell lint`: exit 0, with 0 errors. The new test files add `no-explicit-any` warnings only, in the same `(toast as any)` form their neighbours use.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`, `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (`0 new citation(s)`), `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0.
- Hand-derived from the diff: `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:unreferenced-sources`: exit 0.
- Dependency closure built first: `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2`, with 28 of 28 tasks successful.

## Acceptance notes (boundaries; none of these is filed)

- The terminal toast inserts the action's copy as written. It does not fill `${result.*}` tokens. The spec declares that interpolation for `type: 'api'` and `type: 'script'` actions only, so a flow action's message is plain text. A straight-through run still goes through the action runner, which fills tokens for any action.
- A straight-through run whose action declares no `successMessage` still toasts the runner's default text, not the flow's own `successMessage`. This predates the PR. `FlowSchema.successMessage` names the screen-flow UI as its toast consumer, so the console promises nothing more for that path.
- The runtime-only `ActionDef.toast.showOnSuccess` (not a spec key) was never applied to `FlowRunner`'s terminal toast, and this PR does not change that.
